entity.description: One row is a submitted GitHub pull request review by an account.

fields.conventionNote: Text may contain Markdown and HTML comment markup; search as free text rather than expecting plain prose.
fields.long: Free-form body attached to the pull request review. An empty string likely means the review was submitted without a written body; populated content can include Markdown, HTML comments, and links.
fields.short: Submitted review body text and any embedded review-summary markup.

fields.conventionNote: Use the lowercase 40-character hexadecimal SHA literal; it is not a shortened commit hash.
fields.long: Full Git object ID for the commit revision associated with this review. It is a reference for matching commits and joins, not a numeric quantity.
fields.short: Git commit SHA reviewed by this pull request review.

fields.long: Platform-level identifier for this submitted pull request review. Use it to identify or join the review record, not for arithmetic.
fields.short: Unique GitHub identifier for the pull request review.

fields.conventionNote: Written as UTC `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.fraction+00`; include the numeric offset when using an exact literal.
fields.long: Timestamp recording when this pull request review was observed in this dataset, rather than when the review was submitted. The displayed +00 offset establishes UTC.
fields.short: Timestamp when this review record was observed.

fields.long: Reference to the pull request that received this review. Use it to join review records to their pull request, not as a numeric measure.
fields.short: Pull request referenced by this review.

fields.conventionNote: Use the full lowercase HTTPS URL, including the `#pullrequestreview-` fragment, for an exact review link.
fields.long: Canonical GitHub URL locating this review within its pull request, including a review-specific fragment. It is a link value rather than a stable numeric key.
fields.short: GitHub web URL for the submitted pull request review.

fields.long: Reference to the account associated with this submitted review. Use it to join to account details, not as a numeric measure.
fields.short: Account that submitted the pull request review.

fields.conventionNote: Use uppercase GitHub state literals, such as `APPROVED`; do not query with lowercase labels.
fields.long: Review state as a GitHub status category, such as approval, comment-only review, dismissal, pending review, or requested changes. These are unordered workflow categories rather than a ranked scale; pending and dismissed reviews require explicit inclusion semantics.
fields.short: GitHub disposition of the submitted pull request review.

fields.conventionNote: Written as UTC `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS+00`; use a space between date and time, not `T`.
fields.long: Timestamp for submission of this pull request review. The displayed +00 offset establishes UTC.
fields.short: Timestamp when the pull request review was submitted.
